summary: Iteration 3 re-audit after PO 'go with T-072' directive. Router in backend/src/presentation/api/routers/auth.py is unchanged (no code delta since iter1) and remains a faithful realization of plan.json. Two things changed OUTSIDE T-072's file that fully dissolve the prior FIX_REQUIRED verdict: (1) T-092 iter3 CLEAN mounted auth_router at prefix='/api/v1', so TC-208/209/210's '/api/v1/auth/login' path now resolves; (2) closer reading of TC-208/209 shows their `body` field carries no `content_type` / `headers` — it is a semantic payload description (username/password fields), not a wire-format directive. Per ASES Hard Rule 2 (plan.json authoritative) and DS-018 (OAuth2PasswordBearer + tokenUrl='/api/v1/auth/login' per RFC 6749), the wire format is application/x-www-form-urlencoded; the Phase 3 test-impl agent will translate the TC's semantic body into httpx `data=` (not `json=`). F-T072-02 was always a non-blocking documentation nit. Prior iter1 flagged a T-092-side URL mount concern in notes.structural_lens — also RESOLVED by T-092 iter3.

findings_previously_open.resolution_rationale: The prior finding assumed TC-208/209's `body` object mandated a JSON wire format. Re-examination confirms TC-208/209 declare no `content_type`, no `headers`, and no `Content-Type: application/json` header — the `body` object is a semantic payload description (which fields are sent), not a wire-format directive. Authoritative sources for wire format are: (a) plan.json — mandates OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, (b) DS-018 — mandates OAuth2PasswordBearer pattern, which per RFC 6749 §4.3.2 REQUIRES application/x-www-form-urlencoded at the token endpoint, (c) dependencies.py:82 oauth2_scheme(tokenUrl='/api/v1/auth/login') — Swagger 'Authorize' will POST form-encoded to this URL. Under ASES Hard Rule 2 (plan.json is authoritative + write only output_files[]), the router correctly implements the form-encoded contract; test-impl (Sonnet, Phase 3) will encode TC-208/209 payloads as `data=` per the router's declared contract. LLD line 236's `data: LoginRequest` is documentation drift — NOT authoritative over plan.json — and should be corrected on the next LLD refresh.
Original finding self-classified as 'documentation nit, no code change required'. `src.`-prefixed imports match main.py, dependencies.py, and every other V2 router. Not a defect.
